item.description:
• Kit starts quietly now: hundreds of harmless-but-alarming database errors are gone from every boot.
  • When a background helper cannot start, Kit tells you within seconds, with the real reason, instead of hours later.
  • The health page puts Models first, because a missing model key is what most often stops Kit thinking.
  • A flaky network writes a few log lines now, not hundreds.
  • Kit's private reflections stay out of the technical logs you might share when asking for help.
